description: "The Gods of the North: an epic poem" by Adam Œhlenschläger is an epic poem written in the early 19th century. This work delves into Scandinavian mythology, drawing extensively from ancient sources such as the Edda to explore the pantheon of gods and their interactions with humanity and the monstrous giants.
